answer: PoA binds every identity to bonded collateral escrow, making coordinated equivocation by k identities provable as a correlated event and imposing penalties that scale quadratically, O(k^2), rather than as k isolated fines. Once detection is finalized, asymmetric capital depreciation applies an exponential multiplier to the loss, rapidly exhausting aggregate stake and raising the cost of a sybil swarm. An inlet, jetty, or violet label cannot evade this linkage.
